definition: Strikingly strange, unusual, or unlike what is considered normal.
author: Mark Twain
quote: Well, there was a big outlandish parrot on each side of the clock, made out of something like chalk, and painted up gaudy.
example_sentence: He turned up to the interview in an outlandish purple suit.
